description.p: Desktop client for Mahfin, built on Qt WebEngine and libmpv. Playback is handled by mpv rather than the browser, so files are played as they are on disk: Matroska, HEVC, 10-bit, DTS, TrueHD and multi-track audio all decode natively and the server does not transcode.
Also supports audio passthrough and hardware decoding.
First release, forked from Jellyfin Desktop 2.0.0.

ul.li: Rebranded throughout, with its own application ID and config paths
Ships pointed at the Mahfin server, so the connect screen is skipped
Playback driven by mpv directly from the Mahfin web client
